comments.text: Watching Amish country feels like discovering someone found the “unsubscribe” button for modern life centuries ago. That’s such a great way to put it. Sometimes it really does seem like the Amish found a way to step away from the noise without stepping away from meaningful work, family, and community. We have so many tools meant to make life easier, yet somehow they often make us feel busier.

If you had to give up just one part of modern life for a month, what would be the easiest thing for you to live without?
